summary: Final full-branch backend and QA/system review at clean HEAD 6567e00 found four blockers: lifecycle aggregate versions lack atomic checkpoints, Source track sequences lack gap/stale reconciliation, Source workload authentication regresses the existing Insights caller, and authenticated 429 retries reuse consumed HMAC nonces. Duplicate event IDs also resolve upstream dependencies before the inbox short-circuit.
validation: Both reviewers inspected the complete origin/main...6567e00 candidate across all 19 commits and the REQ-001 through REQ-008 trace
Backend review traced lifecycle invalidation, Source snapshot ingestion, claim ordering, inbox dedupe, generation fencing, and Kafka semantics
QA review cross-checked Source runtime/OpenAPI against the normative Source service specification and existing Insights caller
QA review traced workload-proof nonce consumption across authenticated Source/Model 429 retry paths
Prior supplied evidence remains green: Kafka 9/9, compatibility 30/30, FastSystem 74/74, Release builds, generator checks, and cleanup audits
Candidate HEAD and worktree remained clean; git diff --check passed
No test-stage clean-main/candidate SIGSEGV matrix was run during review
blockers: Lifecycle invalidation accepts delayed/out-of-order aggregate versions because no persisted per-aggregate checkpoint is compared atomically with inbox insertion; stale events can advance fences and enqueue repeated builds.
Source snapshot ingestion has no atomic per-track sequence checkpoint, gap detection, or authoritative reconciliation; sequence gaps and late older snapshots can still cause build/model work.
Source workload authentication and OpenAPI now allow only knowledge-service, rejecting the existing insights-service caller required by the normative Source contract.
HTTP 429 retries clone and reuse the same single-use HMAC proof nonce; after an authenticated 429 consumes the nonce, retry attempts fail as replay instead of recovering.
next_action: Return to code for one bounded final remediation: atomic lifecycle/track checkpoints with stale/gap coverage, restored Knowledge/Insights Source audience consistency, fresh proof generation per 429 attempt, and early duplicate short-circuiting; then rerun focused and full review gates.

issues.title: Lifecycle aggregate versions have no applied checkpoint
issues.details: Persist and atomically compare the highest applied version per lifecycle aggregate with inbox insertion; acknowledge equal/lower versions without fence, supersession, model, or build work.

issues.title: Source track sequences have no gap or stale reconciliation
issues.details: Add an atomic per-track generation/sequence checkpoint, acknowledge stale/already-applied events, and hold/reconcile gaps through authoritative Source state before build work.

issues.title: Source workload audience regresses Insights
issues.details: Align Source authentication, OpenAPI, normative specification, and tests so both existing Knowledge and Insights callers are authorized without broadening unrelated audiences.

issues.title: Authenticated 429 retries reuse a consumed proof nonce
issues.details: Create a fresh workload proof for every retry attempt and cover a nonce-consuming authenticated 429 followed by success for Source and Model paths.

issues.title: Duplicate event IDs resolve upstream dependencies before dedupe
issues.details: Short-circuit an already accepted inbox/event checkpoint before external resolution while retaining the transactional generation-fence check for genuinely new events.
